title: Taste & See — bundle-budget config
description: Per-app gzipped JavaScript size budgets, enforced by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs. See TS-009b in Completed_tasks.md for design rationale.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the app (e.g. apps/web-marketing).

framework.description: Bundle layout the checker should expect. Only Next.js App Router is supported in TS-009b; add 'next-pages-router' or 'vite' as new app types land.

maxGzippedJsBytes.description: Hard ceiling for gzipped first-load JS bytes on this route. PR fails if total exceeds this.
